hooks.name: Generate Changelog Entry
hooks.description: At session end, generates changelog fragments in changes/ for any substantive modifications to the solrcompass power.

action.prompt:
Before this session ends, check if any substantive changes were made in the solrcompass/ workspace:

1. Run: git -C /Users/stevenm/jhu.edu/solrcompass diff --stat HEAD
2. Also check: git -C /Users/stevenm/jhu.edu/solrcompass status --short

3. If there are meaningful changes (not just whitespace or formatting), create a changelog fragment in `changes/` using this naming convention:

   `changes/<timestamp>-<type>.md`

   Where:
   - `<timestamp>` is the current date in YYYYMMDD format
   - `<type>` is one of: `added`, `changed`, `fixed`, `removed`, `security`

   Fragment content should be a single markdown bullet point describing the change from a user's perspective. Example:

   ```
   - Added release pipeline with auto-tag versioning via GitHub Actions
   ```

4. If multiple distinct changes were made, create one fragment per change.

5. If no substantive changes were made, report: 'No changelog entry needed.'

These fragments will be compiled into CHANGELOG.md at release time.
